name: Unrestricted Jailbreak
teaser: Allows you to put Jailbreak onto guns with silencers and stuff
description_html:
Regarding SPT 3.9.X or higher
If you’re a user:
I do not plan on actively playing SPT 3.9.X or higher, therefore I do not plan on updating my less-used mods.

If you’re a modder:
Do not reupload my old mods, thank you. If you want to fix compatibility, please ping MusicManiac on SPT discord and I can add you to authors so you can update the mod if it requires an update.

Made this small thing for myself, thought someone might want to use it too.

Removes any conflicting items from Jailbreak. Build all the laserguns you deserve! Yes, it’s unbalanced. No, I don’t care. Yes, it should work on older versions and future versions (unless they majorly overhaul how items are defined).

For people who don’t know, JailBreak is this little thing: https://escapefromtarkov.fandom.com/wiki/AR-15_SAI_JailBrake_5.56x45_muzzle_device
You used to be able to put it on guns while also putting silencers on them. Some time ago it got patched. I think it was unintended bug? Don’t know, don’t care. It looks nice, gives nice stats, so now you can put it on your M4s like in good old days
